_comment: Manual OpenAlex-id overrides for every institution, verified by hand against https://openalex.org on 2026-08-20. Using direct id lookups (not the name-search endpoint) for all 52 institutions, since OpenAlex's search endpoint proved far more rate-limit-sensitive than plain id retrieval during initial setup. Set an id to null and add an '<id>_reason' key to mark an institution as confirmed absent from OpenAlex.
hiil_reason: No OpenAlex institution record found — HiiL publishes policy reports, not indexed scholarly output.
